en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from `Abd al-`Aziz from Ibn Abi Ya`fur. He said: Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) said:

When you pray an obligatory prayer, then pray it on-time in a meek way, fearing that you will never return to it again. Look to the place of your prostration (humble your sight), for if you knew who was to your right and to your left, you would have perfected your prayer. Know that you are before He who sees you while you cannot see Him.
